function g(a: number, ...r: string[]) { return a + r.length; }
function wrap(...args: [number, ...string[]]) { return g(...args); }
console.log(wrap(2, "x", "y"));
function wrap2(...args: Parameters<typeof g>) { return g(...args); }
console.log(wrap2(1));
function mk(a: number, b = "x", ...r: boolean[]) { return `${a}${b}${r.length}`; }
const p: [number, string?, ...boolean[]] = [1, "y", true];
console.log(mk(...p));
const bad: [number, ...number[]] = [1, 2];
g(...bad);
function two(a: number, b: number) { return a + b; }
two(...bad);
const q: [string, ...string[]] = ["s"];
g(...q);
